title: Welcome to STCK
summary: Why we built an independent, evidence-based supplement reference — and what's coming next.
body:
We built STCK because most supplement content online is either trying to sell you something or hiding behind vague claims. Every entry in our library summarizes real, published research — no sponsored rankings, no affiliate links.

This News section is where we'll share updates: new research worth knowing about, new stacks, and changes to the site itself. Check back regularly.
